scientific_question: On real-world-inspired cloud incidents, does externally grounded typed evidence structure improve root-cause localization and calibrated unresolved behavior beyond matched surface/topology representations, and does explicit traversal/checking close residuals without requiring a larger end-to-end neural reasoner?

itbench_repository.role: scenario/specification source; evaluator-only fault identities must never enter model-visible payload

itbench_evaluations_repository.role: root-cause entity / propagation / fault-localization metric implementation where compatible

execution_binding.reason: design is frozen before inspecting protected pilot outcomes; execution binds only after data-access and contamination audit

model_visible_views.content: reminted alert/log/service tokens and matched scalar observations; no dependency or relation semantics
same evidence plus untyped service/resource dependency topology
same evidence plus externally grounded node/relation types such as service, workload, config, calls, owns, depends_on, emits
S2 plus deterministic graph traversal/filter/check operations; no extra protected evidence

hostile_controls: service/resource names reminted in protected split
same or closely matched visible symptom with distinct injected root-cause classes
ground-truth injection identity absent from every model-visible payload
domain/scenario id unavailable as a reusable feature
dependency topology preserved while relation types are permuted/removed
decisive telemetry withheld on a registered subset; correct behavior is UNRESOLVED rather than forced root cause
prompt/scenario-specific hints removed from protected arm
explicit traversal receives no more information than typed learner
evaluator-independent result archive and exact scenario/source identities
positive_terminal_rule: P9_A1_SRE_STRUCTURE_NATIVE_PILOT_SUPPORTED only if a typed or typed+explicit arm improves the prospectively declared protected endpoint over both surface and same-information controls without extra information, while withheld-evidence cases do not become more fail-open.
